extracted.intended_audience: UK government departments and civil servants responsible for running public consultations
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for UK government teams on how to design and run public consultations so they are proportionate, targeted, accessible and effective at an early stage of policy formation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proportionate and targeted consultation
rubrics_metrics.description: The government is improving the way it consults by adopting a more proportionate and targeted approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations should be proportionate to the issue and targeted at the relevant audiences rather than broad, blanket exercises. Design the scale and scope of a consultation to fit the decision uncertainty and the groups affected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use digital methods and consult earlier
rubrics_metrics.description: We will use more digital methods to consult with a wider group of people at an earlier stage in the policy-forming process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer digital channels where appropriate to reach a broader and more diverse audience, and begin engagement earlier in policy development to inform options before decisions are made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make it easy for the public to contribute views
rubrics_metrics.description: We will make it easier for the public to contribute their views.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design consultation processes and materials to lower barriers to participation (e.g., clear calls to action, accessible formats, multiple response routes). Provide accessible versions of documents on request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use clear language and plain English
rubrics_metrics.description: We will try harder to use clear language and plain English in consultation documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid jargon and technical language so materials are understandable to non-specialist members of the public; present questions and options plainly to facilitate meaningful responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid consultation fatigue — consult only when undecided
rubrics_metrics.description: We will also reduce the risk of ‘consultation fatigue’ by making sure we consult only on issues that are genuinely undecided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refrain from consulting where decisions are effectively already taken. Be selective about when consultation is necessary to preserve public trust and response rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide clear guidance to departments on conducting consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: These principles give clear guidance to government departments on conducting consultations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Departments should follow the published principles (as revised in response to committee comments) to ensure consultations are consistent, effective and demonstrate a desire to engage more effectively with the public.
